/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import pysam, re
bam=pysam.AlignmentFile('aln_primary.sorted.bam','rb')
# per transcript primary alignments counts and covered bases/depth
from collections import defaultdict
cnt=defaultdict(int); cov=defaultdict(int); bases=defaultdict(int)
for aln in bam.fetch(until_eof=True):
    if aln.is_unmapped: continue
    r=aln.reference_name
    if r is None: continue
    cnt[r]+=1
    # count covered reference positions from alignment blocks
    for start,end in aln.get_blocks():
        cov[r]+=end-start
        bases[r]+=aln.reference_length or 0
bam.close()
# load ref lengths
lengths={}
with open('gencode.v47.transcripts.fa') as f:
    name=None; seq=[]
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('>'):
            if name: lengths[name]=len(''.join(seq))
            name=line[1:].strip()
            seq=[]
        else: seq.append(line.strip())
    if name: lengths[name]=len(''.join(seq))
rows=[]
for r,c in cnt.items():
    L=lengths.get(r,0)
    rows.append((c,cov[r]/L if L else 0,cov[r],L,r))
rows.sort(reverse=True)
for c,frac,cov,L,r in rows[:100]:
    f=r.split('|')
    print(f'{c}\\t{frac:.2f}\\t{cov}\\t{L}\\t{f[5] if len(f)>5 else \"?\"}\\t{r}')
PY"

import sys
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from itertools import combinations
# collect all alignment records by read
reads=defaultdict(list)
for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    q=p[0]; flag=int(p[1]); rna=p[2]; cigar=p[5]
    gene='*'
    if rna"'!='"'*':
        f=rna.split('|'); gene=f[5] if len(f)>5 else rna
    reads[q].append((flag,rna,gene,cigar,p))
# stats
total=len(reads); supp=0; multi_gene=0; pair=Counter(); gene_counts=Counter()
soft=0; unmapped=0
chimeric_candidates=[]
for q,recs in reads.items():
    genes=set()
    has_primary=any((f & 0x900)==0 and f&4==0 for f,_,_,_,_ in recs)
    for f,rna,g,cigar,p in recs:
        if f & 0x900: # secondary or supplementary
            pass
        if f & 4: unmapped+=1
        if g"'!='"'*': genes.add(g)
        # soft clip primary
        if (f & 0x904)==0 and 'S' in cigar: soft+=1
    if any(f & 0x800 for f,_,_,_,_ in recs): supp+=1
    gs=sorted(genes)
    if len(gs)>1:
        multi_gene+=1
        for a,b in combinations(gs,2):
            pair[(a,b)]+=1
        chimeric_candidates.append((q,recs))
print('reads',total,'supplementary',supp,'multi_gene',multi_gene,'soft_primary',soft,'unmapped_records',unmapped)
print('TOP GENE PAIRS (co-occurring reads, any alignments):')
for (a,b),n in pair.most_common(100): print(n,a,b)
print('Example chimeric candidates:')
for q,recs in chimeric_candidates[:10]:
    print('\\n',q)
    for f,rna,g,cigar,p in recs:
        print(f, g, rna, cigar, p[9][:40] if len(p)>9 else '')
PY"

import sys,re
from collections import defaultdict,Counter

def gene_of(rna):
    if rna=='*': return '*'
    f=rna.split('|'); return f[5] if len(f)>5 else rna
recs=defaultdict(list)
for line in open('contigs_to_tx.sam'):
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    p=line.rstrip().split('\\t')
    if len(p)<11: continue
    recs[p[0]].append(p)
# get lengths/cov from name
rows=[]
for q,rs in recs.items():
    m=re.match(r'NODE_\\d+_length_(\\d+)_cov_([0-9.]+)',q)
    L=int(m.group(1)) if m else 0; cov=float(m.group(2)) if m else 0
    genes=Counter(); mapped=0
    for p in rs:
        if int(p[1])&4: continue
        g=gene_of(p[2]); genes[g]+=1; mapped+=1
    distinct=sum(1 for g,n in genes.items() if g"'!='"'*')
    if distinct>1:
        rows.append((cov,L,q,genes))
for cov,L,q,genes in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:100]:
    # skip pseudogenes/lncRNA? print all
    print(f'{cov:.2f}\\t{L}\\t{dict(genes.most_common(10))}\\t{q}')

import re,gzip
from collections import defaultdict

# parse gtf exons
exons=defaultdict(list)
trans_info={}
with gzip.open('gencode.v47.annotation.gtf.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(p)<9 or p[2]"'!='"'exon': continue
        d=dict(re.findall(r'(\\S+)\\s+\"(["'^"]*)"'"',p[8]))
        tid=d.get('transcript_id',''); gname=d.get('gene_name',''); tname=d.get('transcript_name',''); en=d.get('exon_number','')
        trans_info[tid]=(gname,tname)
        exons[tid].append((int(p[3]),int(p[4]),p[6],en))

def exon_at(tid, pos0):
    # pos0 0-based transcript coordinate. Return exon number/start0/end0 and gene
    ex=sorted(exons.get(tid,[]))
    if not ex: return None
    strand=ex[0][2]
    ordered=ex if strand=='+' else list(reversed(ex))
    cum=0; prev=[]
    for i,(start,end,strand,en) in enumerate(ordered,1):
        L=end-start+1
        if cum <= pos0 < cum+L:
            return (i,en,cum,cum+L,start,end,strand)
        cum+=L
    return None

# parse BWA SAM for NODE_63_rc, primary and supplementary; only alignments with flag <=2048, mapped
recs=[]
for line in open('NODE_63_rc_bwa.sam'):
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    p=line.rstrip().split('\\t')
    if len(p)<11: continue
    flag=int(p[1]); if flag&4: continue
    rna=p[2]; cigar=p[5]; pos=int(p[3])-1
    # parse cigar to get query intervals and ref intervals
    q=0; r=pos; blocks=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r'(\\d+)([MIDNSHP=X])',cigar):
        n=int(m.group(1)); op=m.group(2)
        if op in 'M=X':
            blocks.append((q,q+n,r,r+n)); q+=n; r+=n
        elif op=='I': q+=n
        elif op=='D' or op=='N': r+=n
        elif op=='S': q+=n
        elif op=='H': pass
        elif op=='P': pass
    f=rna.split('|'); gene=f[5] if len(f)>5 else rna; tid=f[0]
    gname,tname=trans_info.get(tid,(gene,''))
    for qs,qe,rs,re in blocks:
        recs.append((qs,qe,rs,re,gene,tid,tname,flag))

# sort by query start and print overlapping/ordered segments
recs.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0], -x[3]))
# merge adjacent same gene intervals for display
for qs,qe,rs,re,gene,tid,tname,flag in recs:

from Bio import SeqIO
from Bio.Seq import Seq
s=str(SeqIO.read('NODE_63_rc.fa','fasta').seq)
for frame in range(3):
    seq=Seq(s[frame:])
    prot=seq.translate(to_stop=False)
    # longest ORF in this frame
    import re
    orfs=[(m.start(),m.end()) for m in re.finditer(r'M["'^'"\\*]*\\*',str(prot))]
    longest=max(orfs,key=lambda x:x[1]-x[0],default=None)
    print('frame',frame,'len aa',len(prot),'longest ORF', (longest[1]-longest[0]) if longest else None, prot[:60])
PY"
